_comment: 构建期城市配置（阶段 1，2026-10-03）。build.py 用它填 引擎（app/engine/）里的 {{CITY_*}} 占位符，并注入 CITY_META。运行期的城市数据仍在 src/data-kamloops.js。
title: Kamloops Life Guide
description: What to do, where to go, what to bring — step by step — with a map of verified places across Kamloops. Free, no sign-up, six languages.

deploy._comment: 阶段 4（2026-10-03）。worker：Cloudflare Worker 名（= 网址前缀，决定 *.workers.dev 地址）；wranglerEnv：wrangler.toml 里的环境名，空 = 顶层配置；assetsDir：部署目录；basePath：站点路径（方案 A/C 为 /，方案 B 为 /<city>/）；swCache：service worker 缓存名，STATIC_ASSETS 变了就手动升；pwaLabel/pwaDescription：sw.js 注释和 manifest 用。
deploy.pwaDescription: What to do, where to go, what to bring — step by step — with a map of verified places across Kamloops. Free, no sign-up.
